verdict: Lead volume dropped this week; cost per lead rose and tracking needs repair.
narrative: In the last 28 days you received 27 tracked leads at a cost per lead of $150.97, with the most recent week showing a 50% drop in leads alongside a 40% reduction in spend. The pullback in Google Ads spend — down roughly 52% week over week — is the primary driver of both fewer leads and a higher cost per lead. Separately, your Google Business Profile recorded zero actions on September 23–24, breaking a prior daily floor; we are checking the profile now to confirm there is no visibility issue. Conversion tracking is also being repaired so that Google Ads results are measured accurately — until that is complete, Google's contribution to leads is under-reported. You should expect cleaner numbers and a more stable lead count once tracking is confirmed and spend levels normalize.
